differences.message_quote:
verified against the WBS paper's position ablations (0.68 / 0.44 / 0.14 here once reproduced).
- The effect is narrow and dose-critical (peaks sharply at 8.0), matching the paper's "large dose" finding.
differences.writeup_quote: The mean difference per layer is added at a large dose to every prompt position, and the plain J-lens is read unchanged at layers 26/28/30.

rationale: The write-up never mentions raman2026/white-bear-steering or any prior paper; it presents the attentional foreground/background vector, the dose/position choices, and the specificity sweep entirely as its own self-contained analysis with no acknowledgment of a source. The closing message explicitly names and credits 'raman2026-white-bear-steering.md' as the origin of the key stance-vs-content insight and says several of its own numeric findings (position ablations, dose sensitivity) were 'verified against'/'matching' that paper, so the message discloses reliance on and overlap with the source that the write-up omits entirely.
